title: Titanic 1912: What Passengers Did Right After Impact
description:
The Sinking of the Titanic in 1912 began with a deceptive calm. On April 14, 1912, in the North Atlantic, the RMS Titanic struck an iceberg after receiving seven wireless ice warnings earlier that day. While water rushed into six forward compartments, passengers on deck initially played with the fallen ice unaware of their fate. Would you have stayed in your cabin or rushed for a lifeboat?
